summary.text: Luke S. Rankin is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives for District 14 in Laurens County.
His official page lists his occupation as health insurance advisor, and his committees are Agriculture, Natural Resources and Environmental Affairs and Rules.

paragraphs.text: Rankin was born on August 16, 1997, in Greenville, and earned a B.S. from Southern New Hampshire University in 2020.
He served on the Laurens County Council from 2020 to 2024 and chaired the Laurens County Republican Party from 2021 to 2024.
